additional_info.subject: RE: Webform_incident_SiCharge D_07-04-2025_SN: MP / R8 170002502    ID :5USSB6 CRM:02698000030
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0417269 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Please plan a site visit to check the converter wirings as charger is having CAN communication issue with the converter in DC2.
Try swapping with the faulty converter with the next to it (within DC2), and check if the error still appears.
If error still appears on the same faulty converter then the converter is faulty, if the issue appears on the other one (swapped one) then there might be issue with the wirings. Please trace back the wirings.
Keep a spare converter with you in case a replacement is required.
Power Converter AC/DC 20kW > 8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
✔
Onsite Troubleshooting
✔
End Customer Communication
✔
Spare Part Ordering
✔
Performance monitoring by RC
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
.
If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution and send survey email to the customer.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vishal Dhiman
